text:
Viktor Arvidsson signed with Detroit as a free agent this summer, his fifth NHL team, and at 33 he has given the Red Wings more than they could reasonably expect. He has 15 points in 18 games, 8 goals among them, and 7 power-play points. The Detroit News called him a "productive free-agent signing" on Oct. 31, the day after a hat trick against Chicago.

He still plays the way he always has: small, fearless, around the net. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 9.2 scoring chances per 60 from in front of the net last season, 99th percentile among forwards. This season his chances are up to 1.64 expected goals per 60, and he has scored slightly fewer than they deserve.

The last week has been thinner. Arvidsson has gone three games without a point as Detroit lost four of its last five, though he kept getting shots. The quality is there; we would expect the goals to come back before the shots go away.
headline: Arvidsson has found a home in Detroit
